g.text: Register aircraft — POST /api/aircrafts (US102); the model is stored in another replica
date not in the future) → 400 on error
Aircraft (this replica is now the owner)
[registration found in any replica that answers]
400 Bad Request "Aircraft model not found: E190"
Uniqueness across replicas is best-effort (AP): if a peer is down the check continues
with the replicas that answer, so a duplicate is possible under a partition
or with simultaneous POSTs on two replicas (L2 §3.3).
